policy.promotion_rule: Only Christopher may promote a candidate to approved canon.
policy.reference_rule: Reference assets may guide composition, wardrobe, pose, or mood but never override approved identity or persona canon.
policy.external_renderer_rule: An asset may leave the workstation only when approved_for_external_renderer is true, canon is approved, and usage rights are cleared.

review_items.finding: SHA-256 comparison found no byte-identical images among the 27 active assets.
review_items.decision: No exact duplicate removal is required. Validation fails if duplicate content is added later.

review_items.finding: Four distinct files reuse the same red-dress, hotel-lobby visual setup across true-form/disguise modes and pose or footwear variants.
review_items.decision: Retain as an intentional continuity group. They are supporting references, not independent identity authorities.

review_items.finding: Each hair-down portrait intentionally preserves the face and framing of its braided base anchor.
review_items.decision: Retain as explicit variants. Variant approval remains dependent on approval of its base anchor.

review_items.finding: Legacy scene references depict multiple facial identities and cannot jointly define a stable canonical face.
review_items.decision: Keep them as non-canonical pose, wardrobe, lighting, and scene references. Identity must come from a separately approved anchor set.

review_items.finding: Original source locators and license records are absent for the migrated legacy references and wardrobe images. Christopher confirmed that the identity anchors were AI-generated for his sole use, but no license or provider-output-rights record is attached.
review_items.decision: Record rights as unknown_pending_review, allow no transformations, commit no remote URLs, and prohibit every current asset from external-renderer use until rights are separately cleared.

review_items.finding: All six generated anchors are coherent as a paired true-form/disguise identity set. Their amber-hazel eyes and fine luminous gold freckles differed from the former violet-eye and star-shaped-freckle wording in personality/appearance.md.
review_items.decision: Christopher approved all six anchors on 2026-09-22, explicitly including both hair-down variants, and directed the textual appearance canon to match the images. personality/appearance.md and the emotional-color note were deliberately updated under that authorization. This approval does not clear usage rights or permit external-renderer use.

review_items.finding: Christopher added 13 AI-generated wardrobe references to the local visual library. Generator and provider-output license records were not supplied.
review_items.decision: Retain as local non-canonical wardrobe references with rights unknown_pending_review, no allowed transformations, and external-renderer use disabled until rights are separately cleared.
